name: Takayama Sanmachi
description: Takayama's Sanmachi district — three preserved streets of Edo-period merchant houses, craft shops and sake breweries in the old castle town — is a designated Important Preservation District for Groups of Traditional Buildings (重伝建).
notes: Takayama's Sanmachi district is an open preserved street quarter — freely walkable any time. Sake breweries and craft shops line the three streets.
notesJa: 【見どころ】三町筋は常時散策可能。酒蔵や職人店が軒を連ねる風情ある街並みです。
parking: Paid public parking near the old town (fee varies)
parkingJa: 【駐車場】古い町並み周辺の有料駐車場を利用（場所により異なる）
openingHoursJa: 通りは常時開放（施設により異なる）
